text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: {0} and the two girls were climbing the Tower of Luna without issue, but suddenly, Nanaka stopped...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ルナの塔を順調に登っていく{0}たちだったが、
不意にナナカが立ち止まり──

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: Ahhh, I see. So that's how it is. I completely understand.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あー
なるほど。
そういうことね。
完全に理解した。

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Nanaka-chan? Why did you suddenly stop?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ナナカちゃん？
いきなりどうしたの。

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: Hatsune-taso's secret magic... I understand everything now!
text_block_list.orig_text: ハツネたその魔法の秘密が分かっちゃったんだよ！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Eh? EEEEEEEEEEHHHHHHHHH~!?

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: But I've only been using simple magic so far, you know? I am using it... aren't I?
text_block_list.orig_text:
私、
普通の魔法しか使ってないよ？
使って……
ないよね？

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: Just by observing you closely, Hatsune-taso, I've been able to learn some things even from mere ordinary magic.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ハツネたそをつぶさに観察すれば
普通の魔法からでも
分かることはありますとも。

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: What did you find out?
text_block_list.orig_text: 何が分かったのかな？

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: Oh, perfect timing. I'll show you what I've learned right away, so please watch.
text_block_list.orig_text:
おお、
ちょうどいいところに。
今見せるから
見ていてくだされ。

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeah...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
う、
うん……！

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: Suuuu... Haaaaa....
text_block_list.orig_text:
すぅ～～
はぁ～～……

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: Kiraaan☆
text_block_list.orig_text: きらーんっ☆

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: Gyaoooooo!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ギャオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Um, that was the same magic you've always used so far...right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっと、
今までと変わらない魔法……
だったよね？

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: EXACTLY SO!!
text_block_list.orig_text: そのとーーり！！

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: I'VE REALIZED THAT I DON'T KNOW ANYTHING AT ALL!!!!!
text_block_list.orig_text: 何も分からないということが分かりました！！！！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Eh?
text_block_list.orig_text: へ？

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: Man, I originally thought that I'd be able to discern something by watching that ordinary magic you've been using, Hatsune-taso, but... it turned out to be a dead end.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いやー
ハツネたその普通の魔法から
何かつかめるんじゃないかと思ってたけど、
全然無理だったね。

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: I tried to start by saying the magic words, but, well... maybe my pose wasn't good or something like that...
text_block_list.orig_text:
形から入ってみようとしたんだけど、
うーん、
今のもやっぱりちょっと違ったかな……

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: Kiraaan★! KIRAAAAN! Kira♪ ...Yeah, that's not working.
text_block_list.orig_text:
きらーんっ★　
キラーン！　
綺羅ーん♪
……うん、
離れていっちゃってるね。

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: By the way, Hatsune-taso. Do you ever think about anything when you use that magic?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちなみにハツネたそ。
あの魔法を繰り出すときに
何か考えていることはある？

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Something I think about? Hmm... Ah! Come to think of it, I usually drown in thoughts for someone else when I use it, don't I?
text_block_list.orig_text:
考えてること？　
う～ん……
あ！
そういえば
誰かのためにって考えてることが多い、
かな？

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: Hah!! C-Certainly, now that you mention it, a magical girl's magic is something they use for someone else!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はっ！！　
た、
確かに言われてみれば、
魔法少女の魔法は誰かのために使うもの。

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: How could Nanaka-chan forget the most basics of basics like that... That's exactly right.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ナナカちゃんとしたことが
一番大切なことを忘れてたよ。
そうだよね。

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: I will cast this next spell using the feelings that come straight from my heart. To find the clues towards {0}'s memories... and for the peace in the whole of Landosol!
text_block_list.orig_text:
私、
心を込めて魔法を放つよ。
{0}君の記憶の手がかりのために。
そして、
ランドソルの平和のために。

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: Right here, right now... Take this attack with all my might... Kiraaan☆
text_block_list.orig_text:
今、
渾身の……
きらーんっ☆

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: Gyaoooooo!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ギャオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: Did I do it?!
text_block_list.orig_text: やったか！？

text_block_list.name: Monsters
text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: Uwah, thank you for ruining me walking over theory street right there. But I'll have you know you're no match for the magical girl Nanaka-chan who has re-discovered the basics of this profession!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いやー
セオリー通りのご登場ありがとうございます。
でも、
初心に帰った魔法少女ナナカちゃんの敵じゃないよ！

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: Now! Hatsune-taso, let's join together! Cast some magic together with Nanaka-chan to cheer on her!
text_block_list.orig_text:
さぁ、
ハツネたそも一緒に
魔法を放って
ナナカちゃんを応援しよう！！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Huh?!
text_block_list.orig_text: えっ！？

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: LET'S DO THIS!!!

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeah...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
う、
うん……！

text_block_list.name: Nanaka Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Kiraaan☆
text_block_list.orig_text: きらーんっ☆

text_block_list.name: Monsters
text_block_list.text: Gyaoooooo!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ギャオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: That was amazing, Nanaka-chan! I've never seen an ES-... I mean, I've never seen such a magic spell before!
text_block_list.orig_text:
すごいよナナカちゃん！
私も見たことのない超の……
魔法が出たよ！

text_block_list.name: Punk 1
text_block_list.text: Huh?
text_block_list.orig_text: あん？

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Nanaka...chan?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ナナカ…………
ちゃん？

text_block_list.name: Punk 1
text_block_list.text: Who are you bastards... And where the hell am I...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
んだてめぇら。
それにここはどこだ……？

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: EEEHHH?! NANAKA-CHAN'S TURNED INTO A THUG?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
え～～～～！？
ナナカちゃんがグレちゃった～～！？

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Nanaka has disappeared. In her place, a thug suddenly appears. The search inside the Tower is about to take a turbulent turn.
text_block_list.orig_text:
消えたナナカ。突然現れたごろつき。
塔探索は波乱の展開を迎えるのであった。

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: WHERE DID I EVEN END UP TO?! HATSUNE-TASO!!! {0}-KUN!!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ここはどこでござるかーー！？
ハツネたそ～～！　
{0}君～～！

text_block_list.name: Punk 2
text_block_list.text: Wh-Who the hell are you?! You just showed up out of nowhere! And where the hell is my henchman?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
な、
なんだテメェは！？
いきなり現れやがって！　
オレサマの子分をどこにやりやがった！

text_block_list.name: The Villagers
text_block_list.text: H-Help me!
text_block_list.orig_text:
た、
助けて～～！

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: I don't know what's going on! But I've just rediscovered how the magic of this Magical Girl Nanaka-chan is for the sake of someone else!! Here I come!
text_block_list.orig_text:
何がなんだか分からないでござるが、
魔法少女ナナカちゃんの魔法は誰かのために！！
いくぞー！

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: Please look forward to Magical Girl Nanaka-chan's future exploits!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
魔法少女ナナカちゃんの今後の活躍に
乞うご期待！！
